[[File:GreenAjah.png|right|255px]]

'''Captain-General''' is the title given to the [[Ajah Head|Head]] of the [[Green Ajah]]. In the Green Ajah quarters, her rooms are marked by an upward-pointed sword lacquered in red, gold and black carved into the doorway.

The Green Ajah has a somewhat military hierarchy, as the title suggests, and the Captain-General has a thorough and far-reaching authority over her subordinates. She is assisted by two women who are second in command known as the '''First Strategist''' and '''First Tactician'''.{{ref/book|twotc|Green Ajah}} The identity of either of these roles in association with any named character is not given in the series.

==Title holders==
Prior to her election as Amyrlin Seat, [[Shein Chunla]] held the position. The autocratic nature of her previous role did not work so well with the [[Hall of the Tower]]. She was deposed in a rebellion.<ref>[[The Wheel of Time Companion]], Shein Chunla</ref>

In {{ne|862}}, [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin]] refused to be raised to Captain-General, something that was unheard of in the White Tower.

In {{ne|979}}, [[Kerene Nagashi]] was the Captain-General. Kerene was one of [[Tamra Ospenya's Searchers]] and was murdered by the [[Black Ajah]].

[[Adelorna Bastine]] is the current Captain-General; she also held the position in the Tower during the [[White Tower Schism]]. [[Alviarin Freidhen]] knew of her identity and had [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] (who did not know) publicly punish her and another Green, [[Josaine]], for keeping ''[[angreal]]'' in their rooms, thereby stirring up the animosities that had made the Tower toxic by the time [[Egwene al'Vere]] was captured.

[[Myrelle Berengari]], who was also one of the [[Salidar Six]] and part of [[Egwene al'Vere's Council]], was Captain-General among the [[Rebel Aes Sedai|Rebel]] Greens.
